concepts.name: Flight Echo
concepts.description: Fading cutouts of the actual ball reveal the observed flight in one cinematic frame.
concepts.needs: Reliable ball masks and continuous tracked frames.
concepts.detail: Use six translucent photographic copies of the same white and black leather ball at previous observed positions along a believable shallow flight arc. Earlier copies fade gradually, the current ball is opaque and crisp. The arc occupies the middle of the recorded pitch, never an artificial flight beyond the observed ball. No glowing line connecting the copies. Show enlarged ball cutout detail with perfect edges and preserved leather texture.

concepts.name: Heat Wake

concepts.name: Orbit Rings
concepts.description: Decorative light rings wrap around the tracked ball with convincing foreground and background layering.
concepts.needs: Precise ball silhouette and screen-space scale; decorative motion does not measure spin.
concepts.detail: Two elegant thin mint and pale gold gyroscope-like elliptical light rings hug a real football, about 1.5 times ball diameter. Rings tilt in different planes. Back portions disappear correctly behind the opaque ball, front portions pass in front of the leather. Restrained tiny light flecks, no giant Saturn rings. Large detail crop makes the front-back occlusion obvious. Label decorative orbit in small readable text; never show RPM or measured spin.
